sequence: verify signed backend receipt and bindings

covered_rejections: retry preserves original ID/nonce/start and denominator
raw byte drift or missing automatic fields
noninteger, negative or reset client clocks
client terminal failure cannot override server finish
limitations: No callback invocation proves an actual DOM render or trusted instrumentation deployment.
